description.p: Skribisto is a writing app for novels, from the first idea to the finished manuscript.
Skribisto est un logiciel d'écriture pour les romans, de la première idée au manuscrit terminé.

ul.li: Split panes and tabs, and a whole chapter, part or book readable as one text
Écran partagé et onglets, et un chapitre, une partie ou le livre entier à lire comme un seul texte
Corkboard, story bible, margin comments and footnotes
Tableau de liège, bible narrative, commentaires dans la marge et notes de bas de page
Word goals, writing sessions, pace planning and manuscript analysis
Objectifs de mots, sessions d'écriture, planification du rythme et analyse du manuscrit
Statuses you name yourself, from first draft to final
Des statuts que vous nommez vous-même, du premier jet à la version finale
Import from Scrivener, Manuskript, Plume Creator, Word, OpenDocument or Markdown, comments included, with a report of anything left behind
Import depuis Scrivener, Manuskript, Plume Creator, Word, OpenDocument ou Markdown, commentaires compris, avec un rapport de ce qui n'a pas pu être repris
Export to DOCX, ODT, EPUB, PDF and more, and finish the page layout in the program you prefer
Export en DOCX, ODT, EPUB, PDF et d'autres formats, pour finir la mise en page dans le logiciel de votre choix
Search and replace, autosave, backups and version history
Rechercher et remplacer, enregistrement automatique, sauvegardes et historique des versions
Spell checking, smart punctuation and 24 interface languages
Correcteur orthographique, ponctuation intelligente et interface en 24 langues
Built for accessibility: screen readers, braille displays and keyboard shortcuts
Pensé pour l'accessibilité : lecteurs d'écran, plages braille et raccourcis clavier

screenshot.caption: The binder and the editor, with prose and its synopsis side by side
Le classeur et l'éditeur, avec le texte et son synopsis côte à côte
The launcher, listing recent projects and bundled examples
Le lanceur, avec les projets récents et les exemples fournis

ul.li: Each book now has its own cover. Open the book and choose its cover on the book's own page, where you can also see it, change it or remove it. When you export one book, its cover opens the file, and when you export several books together, each one starts with its own cover. An EPUB carries the cover only when the export style asks for it and the export holds one whole book. Covers chosen in an earlier version are not carried over, so choose them again; the pictures are still in your project
In a Word or OpenDocument export, the cover and every other picture fit within the page margins. A large picture used to be printed at its own size and run off the page
The cover and the title page of a Word or OpenDocument export carry no page header and no page number, and the page numbers start at 1 on the first page of the text

An export titles the book with the book's own title: on the title page, in the page header and in the file's details. It used to use the name of the project file. A project holding several books still uses the project's title when you export them together
When the export style has no title page, the book's title is centred at the start of the book. It used to sit on the left like an ordinary heading
The cover, the author line, the word count and the scene break marks of an export are no longer indented like the first line of a paragraph

An OpenDocument export keeps the scene break mark your export style chooses, such as # in the standard manuscript style. It used to replace it with a horizontal line. Imported back into Skribisto, a stronger scene break also stays a stronger one
In a Word export, a paragraph keeps its own line spacing when it also has space above or below it
Importing a Word or OpenDocument file starts a new page where the file starts a new page with a new section, and no longer where a section continues on the same page
